outcome: Give eCommerce teams a working Customer Lifetime Value & Churn Propensity Engine capability on their own data — it concentrates retention budget on at-risk, high-value customers.
overview: Keeping a customer costs roughly a fifth of what winning a new one costs, yet retention budget is still largely spent as blanket promotion across a list that includes customers who were never going to leave. The Customer Lifetime Value & Churn Propensity Engine scores every customer for churn risk and predicted lifetime value from order history, browsing, marketing engagement and returns, then maintains dynamic micro-segments the campaign tools can act on. Offer design and discount economics stay with the marketing team. Redington measures the customer’s existing churn rate and retention-campaign ROI first, then delivers the working engine on their own data within four weeks.
